Agent: web-builder

Target release: v0.3.0
Assigned to: Kai Nakamura
Source: WO-194 / `docs/vendor/CODEX_SITE_REFRESH.md`

## Goal
Present the current product process as a clear, modern sequence that is easy to follow.

## Acceptance criteria
- Preserve verified process details and existing approved copy; do not imply that Free My ID itself contacts websites or guarantees outcomes.
- Import `site-refresh.css` and wrap refreshed content in `.site-refresh`; leave Header/Footer/Base untouched.
- Use a visually clear numbered sequence and original art only where it helps comprehension.
- Add focused built-output checks for the step order and key links.
- Verify 320/360/768/1280 CSS px, Windows 125%/150% scaling, 200% zoom, keyboard access, D6 contrast (body >=7:1; other >=4.5:1), and >=44px tap targets.
- Audit each claim against D8; flag any claim outside its allowed list.

## Allowed paths (the vendor may change ONLY these)
- `web/src/pages/how-it-works/index.astro`
- `tests/codex/test_cx_how_it_works_refresh.py` (new)
- `VENDOR_STATUS.md` (worktree)

## Out of scope / do not touch
No app flow, security/privacy logic, forms, consent, global styles, shared tokens, CSP, or dependencies.

## Required checks
- `cd web && pnpm build`
- `PYTHONPATH=src FREEMYID_REQUIRE_WEB_DIST=1 ../../.venv/bin/pytest -q tests/codex/test_cx_how_it_works_refresh.py`
- `ruff check tests/codex/test_cx_how_it_works_refresh.py`
- `pnpm check` from `web/`

Owner-prepared worktree after WO-200 is integrated on a main containing reviewed WO-195 and WO-196.
